import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

base = Path('/root/autodl-tmp/symbolic_dynamics/papers/212-closed-pointer-orbits')
expected_files = sorted([
    'CLAIMS_EVIDENCE.md', 'NARRATIVE_REPORT.md', 'ORIGINAL_INPUT_PINS.sha256',
    'OUTPUT_PLAN.md', 'OUTPUT_SCHEMA.md', 'PAPER_PLAN.md', 'PARAMETERS.json',
    'PROOF_PACKAGE.md', 'README.md', 'SOURCE_AUDIT.md', 'SOURCE_PREP_HANDOFF.md',
    'main.tex', 'math_commands.tex', 'references.bib', 'verify.py',
    'sections/01_setup.tex', 'sections/02_returns.tex', 'sections/03_period_set.tex',
    'sections/04_census.tex', 'sections/05_scope.tex'
])
records = []
def check(name, observed, expected):
    equal = json.dumps(observed, sort_keys=True) == json.dumps(expected, sort_keys=True)
    records.append({'name': name, 'observed': observed, 'expected': expected, 'passed': equal})

paths = sorted(p for p in base.rglob('*') if p.is_file())
check('exact_preseal_payload_set', [p.relative_to(base).as_posix() for p in paths], expected_files)
check('no_symlinks', [p.relative_to(base).as_posix() for p in base.rglob('*') if p.is_symlink()], [])
check('only_sections_directory', sorted(p.relative_to(base).as_posix() for p in base.rglob('*') if p.is_dir()), ['sections'])
texts = {name: (base / name).read_text(encoding='utf-8') for name in expected_files}
check('all_payloads_nonempty', all(texts.values()), True)
check('all_payloads_end_lf', all(value.endswith('\n') for value in texts.values()), True)

def unique_pairs(pairs):
    value = {}
    for key, item in pairs:
        if key in value:
            raise ValueError('duplicate parameter key: ' + key)
        value[key] = item
    return value

def reject_numeric(value):
    raise ValueError('noninteger parameter token: ' + value)

parameters = json.loads(texts['PARAMETERS.json'], object_pairs_hook=unique_pairs,
                        parse_float=reject_numeric, parse_constant=reject_numeric)
expected_parameters = {
    'schema': 'p212-parameters-v1', 'carrier_sizes': [1, 2, 3, 4],
    'label_base': 1, 'carrier': '[n]^2 x [n]^[n]',
    'state_order': 'lexicographic (u,v,f(1),...,f(n))',
    'update': 'R(u,v,f)=(v,f(v),f[v:=u]); simultaneous old-state RHS',
    'edge_identity': 'none; undirected multiplicities only', 'loop_degree': 2,
    'series_max_core_size': 4,
    'fixed_iterates': 'all integers 1 through the predicted maximum period in each carrier',
    'expected_state_counts': [1, 16, 243, 4096], 'expected_total_states': 4356,
    'unobserved_core_first_sizes': [5, 6, 5], 'output_schema': 'p212-full-output-v1'
}
check('exact_parameter_document', parameters, expected_parameters)
tex_names = [name for name in expected_files if name.endswith('.tex')]
tex = '\n'.join(texts[name] for name in tex_names)
labels = re.findall(r'\\label\{([^}]+)\}', tex)
references = re.findall(r'\\(?:eqref|ref)\{([^}]+)\}', tex)
bib_keys = re.findall(r'@\w+\{([^,]+),', texts['references.bib'])
cites = [key.strip() for group in re.findall(r'\\cite(?:\[[^\]]*\])?\{([^}]+)\}', tex) for key in group.split(',')]
check('tex_unique_labels', len(labels), len(set(labels)))
check('tex_unresolved_references', sorted(set(references) - set(labels)), [])
check('tex_citations_resolve', sorted(set(cites) - set(bib_keys)), [])
check('bibliography_all_five_primary_keys', sorted(bib_keys), ['berdine2006', 'holroyd2008', 'loginov2007', 'manna1987', 'pham2015'])
check('bibliography_all_entries_cited', sorted(set(bib_keys) - set(cites)), [])
check('tex_ascii', all(texts[name].isascii() for name in tex_names), True)
check('anonymous_manuscript', re.findall(r'\\author\{([^}]+)\}', texts['main.tex']), ['Anonymous'])
input_names = re.findall(r'\\input\{([^}]+)\}', texts['main.tex'])
check('all_tex_inputs_present', [name for name in input_names if not (base / (name + '.tex')).is_file()], [])
check('tex_input_count', len(input_names), 6)
for name in tex_names:
    value = texts[name]
    level = 0
    negative = False
    for brace in re.findall(r'(?<!\\)[{}]', value):
        level += 1 if brace == '{' else -1
        negative = negative or level < 0
    check('lexical_brace_balance:' + name, [level, negative], [0, False])
    stack = []
    mismatch = []
    for action, environment in re.findall(r'\\(begin|end)\{([^}]+)\}', value):
        if action == 'begin':
            stack.append(environment)
        elif not stack or stack.pop() != environment:
            mismatch.append(environment)
    check('lexical_environment_balance:' + name, [stack, mismatch], [[], []])
    check('lexical_inline_math_parity:' + name, len(re.findall(r'(?<!\\)\$', value)) % 2, 0)
check('seven_table_data_rows', len(re.findall(r'^(?:Figure-eight|Barbell|Theta|Any other theta).* & ', texts['sections/02_returns.tex'], re.M)), 7)
check('no_manuscript_or_verifier_todo_tokens', re.findall(r'\b(?:TODO|FIXME|TBD|PLACEHOLDER)\b', tex + texts['verify.py']), [])
check('literal_import_statements_only_stdlib', re.findall(r'^(?:import .+|from .+ import .+)$', texts['verify.py'], re.M),
      ['import itertools', 'import json', 'import math', 'import sys', 'from fractions import Fraction'])
predicate_block = re.search(r'^PREDICATES = \((.*?)^\)', texts['verify.py'], re.M | re.S).group(1)
predicate_names = re.findall(r'"([a-z_]+)"', predicate_block)
check('all_declared_predicate_names_in_schema', [name for name in predicate_names if '`' + name + '`' not in texts['OUTPUT_SCHEMA.md']], [])
check('parameter_schema_literal_in_interface', parameters['output_schema'] in texts['OUTPUT_SCHEMA.md'], True)
check('canonical_stdout_absent', (base / 'canonical.stdout.json').exists(), False)
check('pdf_absent', list(base.rglob('*.pdf')), [])
check('bytecode_absent', list(base.rglob('*.pyc')), [])
pin_lines = texts['ORIGINAL_INPUT_PINS.sha256'].splitlines()
check('original_pin_line_count', len(pin_lines), 28)
check('original_pin_format', all(re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{64}  docs/[^\n]+', line) for line in pin_lines), True)
check('original_pins_exclude_mutable_central_names', [line for line in pin_lines if 'SYMBOLIC_DYNAMICS_STATE.md' in line or 'PIPELINE_STATE.md' in line], [])
metadata = [{'path': name, 'bytes': len((base / name).read_bytes()),
             'lines': len(texts[name].splitlines()),
             'sha256': hashlib.sha256((base / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for name in expected_files]
result = {'kind': 'p212-source-only-documentary-preseal-check-v1',
          'scope': 'Text, JSON, lexical TeX references, paths and hashes only; no scientific module imported, parsed as Python, compiled or executed; no build.',
          'source_payload_count_before_check_record_and_manifest': len(expected_files),
          'declared_predicate_name_count_metadata_only': len(predicate_names),
          'parameter_field_count': len(parameters), 'tex_label_count': len(labels),
          'files': metadata, 'checks': records,
          'check_count': len(records), 'failed_checks': [r['name'] for r in records if not r['passed']],
          'passed': all(r['passed'] for r in records)}
print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=True))
raise SystemExit(0 if result['passed'] else 1)
